where: The Unrisen Stair (Three Hours site III, the Dawn-that-waited) + after its catch + the Old Light's 5th floor
mood: Sunsketch Bloom: the relit reading - daylight surging back into the drowned garden, the motif sung twice and the second time brighter; the score reaching toward dawn.
core_styles: bright singing pulse-wave lead with lifting phrases
warm second lead answering the melody a bar later in call and response
quick shimmering harp arpeggios over a lush warm string pad bloom
soft full drum kit with light shaker, gentle forward groove

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a sunrise opening: a rapid harp arpeggio sweeping upward, the pad blooming like light breaking the horizon, a bright held chord that springs into the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the radiant hometown-derived melody, warm and lifting, harp shimmering, the bass walking forward}

sections.name: Answer
sections.text: {the melody sung again, now answered phrase by phrase by the warm second lead a bar later, brighter and fuller - call and response}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a hush in E minor and C major, the drums drop out, long reaching notes like a figure facing east and waiting, then a rising build of harp toward the light}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the radiant theme returns in full bloom, both leads together; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme, no ending}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
